## Spec ambiguities

- **REQ-MSG-001 vs REQ-SYNC-002 (identity of the sender on an id collision).** REQ-MSG-001 says transitions are only `queued → sent`, `queued → failed`, and insert. It also says "`sent`, `received` and `failed` are terminal." REQ-SYNC-002 says that for an "Existing id with any other status", the client must "Set status to `sent` if `from == me`, else `received`." The two conflict in one case: a sync response carries a server message with the same `id` as a local `queued` (or `sent`) message, but a different `from` (an id collision with another user's message, before the local POST got its 409). Then REQ-SYNC-002 requires `queued → received` (or `sent → received`), which REQ-MSG-001 forbids. The client follows REQ-SYNC-002 (`src/domain/merge.ts:107`, via `fromWire` at `src/domain/merge.ts:90`). REQ-SYNC-005 handles collisions only for local `failed` messages. The spec should say whether the collision rule also applies to non-`failed` local messages whose server copy differs in `from`.
